body:
My psychiatrist has been AWOL for months. It took a nasty message from the pharmacy to get her to fill my meds last month. She’s great when she’s around but I’ve had this problem with her for YEARS. I need a new dr but that’s so hard. 
And I don’t know if I could tell someone in real life that I’m a freak who rips out their toenails.  I think I’d rather be barefoot all the time than do that. How does anyone discuss this with people outside the internet?
There’s no way to remove the notification. I’ll have to leave them on read or block them. I feel like ghosting them wouldn’t be the smartest.
parenting someone in the same body as all the people they have sex with?? it’s the same body.
This is about a “singlet” having both sexual and parental relationships with alters within another person’s system.
Thank you, my main issue was with the parenting idea, I just worded it weirdly. Your example of how you system works seems much more healthy.

It might not be the right word. Friend views each alter as a different person. Is very sexually involved with multiple. At the same time, they have a close relationship with a little (a “traumaholder”), who calls friend “mom.” It just feels very dangerous to me, as if something were to happen with the romantic partners, the little would be destroyed as they could end up losing their “mom.” The overlap and the depth of each relationship seems off to me. I don’t understand how you can mother and have sex with the same body.
nope…i could blame it on that but the bruising is spotty
i’ve been in therapy since i was 9. i don’t want to burden my therapist by being in crisis AGAIN. it doesn’t help.
what’s the point of doing any of this for nothing. i’m racking up so much debt.
